title: The Australian Economy: Past and Present
college: ANU College of Business and Economics
summary: The course explores the Australian economy in a historical context.
requisiteText: You are not able to enrol in this course if you have previously completed ECHI1001 or ECHI1003 or ECHI1004.

title: World Economy Since 1800
college: ANU College of Business and Economics
summary: This course analyzes historical major economic, political, and social changes in the world economy.
requisiteText: To enrol in this course, you must have completed ECON2101 and ECON2102 or ECON2016. You cannot enrol in this course if you have completed ECHI2006, ECHI2016, or ECHI3019.
